read: N beats L41 on exact@all (+5.8pp) and exact (+11.2pp) with better null discipline, but answers 13 fewer gold fields (82 vs 95), so contains falls. On this surface recall/coverage is the binding constraint for both models, not clause finding: contains is .81-.87 while answered/gold is 73-85%.
